p_value_method: two-sided person-label Monte Carlo permutation with plus-one correction; Holm correction across all32 primary tests

metric_definitions.spine_bend0_abs_deviation: abs(fitted spine_bend0 minus saved canonical spine_bend0)
metric_definitions.spine_bend1_abs_deviation: abs(fitted spine_bend1 minus saved canonical spine_bend1)
metric_definitions.bilateral_hip_rz_mean_abs_deviation: mean absolute fitted-minus-saved-canonical right/left upper-leg local RZ coordinate
metric_definitions.bilateral_knee_bend_mean_abs_deviation: mean absolute fitted-minus-saved-canonical right/left knee-bend coordinate

metric_units: native coordinates; spinal drivers are distributed coefficients, not literal anatomical joint angles
scope: saved original/locked/released conditions and replication weak prior; no development people or sampling repeats
interpretation: exploratory selected-cohort associations; no causal decomposition or anatomical-size ground truth. Non-significance does not establish absence of compensation.
sanity_checks: pass: monotonic/reversed/tied-constant ranks, affine invariance, Holm example and exact tiny permutation distribution
